written.headline: Amateur astronomers use Codex and Astra to search public telescope data for exoplanets
written.summary: Two amateur astronomers used OpenAI's Codex and Astra to analyze public telescope data from millions of stars for signs of distant planets. Their findings have been submitted to professional astronomers for further analysis.
